svg.title: Letta: an agent that edits its own memory
svg.desc: Letta's architecture, with the running example. Writing: the answering agent itself decides mid-turn what to remember and edits its human memory block with a tool call (memory_replace); a sleep-time agent can do this in the background instead. Memory: small text blocks that are in the agent's prompt on every call, plus a history of every message. In July the vegetarian line was replaced in place, with no history kept. Reading: no search is needed for the blocks; the agent may search the message history (recall) with a tool. All six constraints were in the prompt.
svg.text: The memory is a few small text blocks inside the agent's own prompt. The answering agent edits them itself, with tool
